auth.title: Access verification
auth.description: This service requires an API key. The key is used only for this login exchange and is never stored in browser storage or a URL.
auth.installCertificate: Install the HTTPS root certificate first

tls.httpNotice: The service is using HTTP. Browser recording over a LAN IP requires HTTPS.
tls.httpSetup: After generating a certificate, set AUDIO_INTEL_PROTOCOL=https and restart the service. See the project documentation for complete steps.
tls.missingCa: HTTPS is enabled, but the server has no downloadable root CA configured. You can continue past the certificate warning in desktop Chrome or Edge, but this does not verify the server identity.
tls.safety: Install the root certificate and verify its fingerprint before entering an API key or uploading audio. The download is a public certificate and contains no private key.
tls.fingerprintCheck: Compare this fingerprint over a trusted channel with ./service.sh tls fingerprint on the server, or service.cmd tls fingerprint on Windows.
tls.windowsStep: Open the .cer file and install it under Trusted Root Certification Authorities, optionally for Current User. Restart Chrome or Edge.
tls.iosStep: Open the .cer file and install the profile. Then enable full trust under Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings and restart the browser.
tls.temporaryAccess: Desktop Chrome or Edge can use Advanced → Continue on the warning page. The connection remains encrypted, but the server identity is unverified and an active man-in-the-middle could intercept the API key and audio. Safari, iOS, and Firefox are not guaranteed to support this path.
